text:
Marta: quick note from QA: billing mismatches for tenant 'orbit-co' — late delta events don't join to original usage. anyone seen this pattern?
Owen: likely redaction + rehashing. are we hashing before redaction?
Marta: we redact early, then downstream computes sha256 of literal '<REDACTED>'. so joins fail.
Lee: we should emit a stable non-PII join key at ingress. idea: provenance = hmac(token, tenant_key_vN) and store that in envelope. drop raw token.
Sasha: +1. requires key version in provenance id so rotated keys still validate. e.g., prov:v2:abcd...
Owen: ops note: keep tenant_key decrypted in local secure cache; only call KMS for unwrap on rotation. avoid per-event KMS.
Marta: audit needs: can legal request original token mapping? we should persist prov->token mapping encrypted with CWK in tenant-owned audit store. only audit path can decrypt.
Lee: add fingerprint_algo field so clients that precompute fingerprints can include algo version. avoids mismatch.
Sasha: metrics: provenance.verify.fail and provenance.unresolved_late_events. alert if >1% of tenant traffic.
Marta: actions: small RFC to add provenance_id + fingerprint_algo (owner: Lee), spike ingress HMAC + secret cache (owner: Owen), audit storage plan (owner: Sasha).
audit-bot: created TICK-5500: "provenance ingress + audit-store" assigned to Owen,Lee,Sasha.
